visualCharacteristics: Two-up grid (one column at 980px and below) of white rounded cards; each card has a full-bleed linked image header with a dark overlay and the card title over it, then a paragraph and a button.
contentPattern: One row per card: a linked image, a heading, a paragraph and a bold link (button). Cards are split by content, so a new heading or image starts a new card.
usage: Category or product teaser grid on the homepage and listing pages.
reuseGuidance: Use for any set of linked image teasers with a title, short description and a link. Add or remove rows to add or remove cards.
